# Pull Request Template

## What Changed

Brief description of the change.

## Why

Explanation of the motivation and context for this change.

## How Tested

Describe how you tested this change:

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Manual testing steps
- [ ] Verification in local development environment

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added for new functionality or bug fixes
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials in code or logs
- [ ] CI checks pass locally
- [ ] Conventional commit message used (e.g., `feat:`, `fix:`)
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](../CLA.md) (the CLA bot will ask on your first pull request)
